accounting.confirmResetBody: All current groups and accounts will be deleted and replaced by the {name} chart. This cannot be undone.
accounting.applied: Chart of accounts updated: {accounts} accounts and {groups} groups added.

accounting.noEntries: There are no journal entries for this period.
accounting.noChartHint: Set up the chart of accounts first.
accounting.setUpChart: Set up the chart of accounts
accounting.postingIntro: When a POS shift is closed, its sales, collections, VAT, discounts and cost of sales are summarised into one journal voucher using these accounts. Item categories can have their own Sales, Cost of Sales and Inventory accounts, which are used instead of the defaults below.
accounting.postingDefaults: Fill empty ones from the standard chart
accounting.postingMissing: {count} setting(s) still have no account. A shift that needs one is not posted until it is set; it can be posted afterwards.
accounting.postingCategoryNote: Sales, cost of sales and inventory are posted to the accounts on the item's category (Inventory Category Master) when it has them, otherwise to the defaults above.
accounting.partyIntro: Every customer gets a GL account in Sundry Debtors (1200, control type DRS) and every supplier one in Sundry Creditors (2200, control type CRS) when they are saved. The account code is the customer / supplier code and the account name is its name. This opens accounts for the ones that existed before.
accounting.partyPending: {customers} customer(s) and {suppliers} supplier(s) have no account yet.
accounting.partyAllDone: Every customer and supplier has an account.
accounting.partyNoCode: {count} could not get an account because a GL account with the same code already exists.
accounting.codeConflicts: {count} account(s) or group(s) were skipped because this company already uses that code for something else (an older numbering). They were left as they are.
accounting.customerCodeHint: With the Accounts module the customer code is also its account code in GL Master (Sundry Debtors, control type DRS), so it cannot be a code that is already an account.
accounting.supplierCodeHint: With the Accounts module the supplier code is also its account code in GL Master (Sundry Creditors, control type CRS), so it cannot be a code that is already an account.
